spans.s: श्लक्(इ)श्लकि r. 1st cl. (श्लङ्कते) To go, to move.

श्लक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं)
 1. Small, fine, minute.
 2. Gentle, mild, amiable.
3. Honest, sincere.
 4. Plain, even, smooth.
 E. श्लिष् to embrace, क्स्न
aff., the short vowel substituted for the penultimate.
श्लग्(इ)श्लगि r. 1st cl. (श्लङ्गति) To go, to move.

श्लथ् r. 10th cl. (श्लथयति-ते)
 1. To be weak, to be relaxed, loose, flaccid.
2. To hurt or kill.

श्लथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
 1. Loose, flaccid, relaxed.
 2. Dishevelled,
(hair).
 3. Untied, unfastened.
 E. श्लथ् to be relaxed, aff. अच् ।

श्लाघ्(ऋ)श्लाघृ r. 1st cl. (श्लाघते)
 1. To praise, to eulogise.
 2. To flatter, to
coax, to wheedle, (with a dat.)
 3. To boast, (with an inst.)

श्लाघा f. (-घा)
 1. Praise, flattery, eulogium.
 2. Service, obedience.
 3.
Wish, desire.
 4. Self-praise.
 E. श्लाघ् to praise, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।

श्लाघित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, commended.
 E. श्लाघ् to praise, क्त aff.

श्लाघ्य mfn. (-घ्यः-घ्या-घ्यं) Venerable, respectable, praise-worthy, entitled
to praise or veneration.
 E. श्लाघा praise, यत् aff.
